identity.name: Briar Snare
identity.summary: A loop of thorny vine around a wide wooden trigger.
identity.description: Costs 1 stamina per activation. Applies 2 poison through the existing combat keyword rules per affordable activation. Reduces each enemy strike this round by 1.
identity.lore: Hunters learned to leave the green thorns facing outward.

effects.description: Costs 1 stamina per activation. Applies 2 poison through the existing combat keyword rules per affordable activation. Reduces each enemy strike this round by 1.
effects.condition: Equipped; class restriction satisfied; all activation costs can be paid together.

synergies.description: Orthogonal adjacency support and available mana/stamina determine the best arrangement. Strategic combinations grant no unlisted bonus.
